scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --dir artifacts/mockup-sandbox run build && pnpm --dir artifacts/tshirt-studio run build && pnpm --dir artifacts/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --dir artifacts/mockup-sandbox run typecheck && pnpm --dir artifacts/tshirt-studio run typecheck && pnpm --dir artifacts/api-server run typecheck && pnpm --dir scripts run typecheck
